Description

### Spectral White Edition: Redefining Elegance in Gaming Tech

The RX 7900 XT Hellhound Spectral White Edition stands as a pinnacle of design in the world of graphics cards. It boasts a harmonious all-white PCB and heatsink, creating a sleek, unified aesthetic that's a first in the industry. This card is more than just a powerhouse of performance; it's a centerpiece that will elevate the look of any gaming setup.

### It's not just about aesthetics

Beneath its sleek exterior lies the same raw power and performance that the Hellhound series is renowned for. With state-of-the-art cooling, lightning-fast clock speeds, and a unique LED lighting system with three modes - blue, white, and off, controlled via a physical switch - this edition promises to deliver an unparalleled gaming experience.

1. Metal Reinforced Backplate

2. Dual BIOS

3. High Quality 14-Layer PCB Design

4. DrMOS with IMON Digital Monitoring

5. Brand New Amethyst LED Color

6. Optimum Heatpipe Arrangement

7. Ring-fan Blade Design

### High Quality Japanese Dual Ball Bearings

Dual ball bearings reduce rotational friction, providing excellent heat dissipation and effectively doubling the expected lifetime of the fans.

### Intelligent Fan Controller

Utilizing temperature detection from a smart chip, fans will start running when the GPU reaches 60℃ and shut down below 50℃. Efficient cooling, fan-noise reduction, and extended product lifetime are all benefits of a more accurate temperature monitoring.

### Unprecedented Ring-fan Blade Design

The newest 9-blade design of our fans generate better airflow and air pressure under the same noise level, improving cooling performance to reduce GPU temperatures by more than 3℃ compared to previous generations.

### GPU Direct-Contact Copper Plate

We have increased the copper plate area to provide direct contact with the GPU while covering VRAM to increase the heat transfer threshold to the max.

### Vertical Fin Heatsink

A brand new white heatsink with closely spaced vertical fins is mounted on the PCB, offering a larger heat-spreading area and improved heat radiation. This allows airflow to efficiently disperse heat.

### Turbulence Reducing Fan Rotation

The middle fan spins in the reverse way so as to reduce the air turbulence between neighboring fans when drawing in cool air. The mechanism therefore maximizes the air flow and pressure when less turbulence occurs to offset, further to lower the noise level without sacrificing the cooling efficiency.

### Optimum Heatpipe Arrangement

A set of 8 x 6φ fresh new white nickel-plated copper heatpipes align closely above the PCB to more quickly and effectively transfer heat from the GPU and VRAM to the cooling array.

### Car-Grade Power Module DrMOS with iMON Real Time Digital Monitoring

Hellhound adopts a 10+3+1 phase VRM design with DrMOS to power the GPU as well as an additional 2+1 phase specifically designated for the VRAM. New IMON technology monitors and reports the electric current and power consumption on each individual phase. By balancing the workload, the Hellhound ensures unparalleled stability and thermal protection during overclocking. In addition, high quality car-grade polymer capacitors features long-lasting durability and high conductivity lowers power loss during transmission.

### High Quality PCB Design

A premium 14-layer high TG PCB Board -including a 2 oz power layer- is utilized in the Hellhound RX 7900 XT; a PCB such designed decreases signal loss during transmission: important especially for higher-end GPUs with increased demands for higher currents and stability.

### Anti-Sag Bracket

A robust metal bracket is installed on the side of the PCB and is supported all the way to the I/O plate, making the card stand firmly in place inside the chassis.

### Metal Reinforced Backplate

The metal backplate strengthens and protects the internal components from PCB bend, and a cut-out design on the back plate allows exhaust heat to properly flow through for heat-dissipation efficiency.

### Ice Blue and Glacier White LED Color

Hellhound of this generation now comes with two LED color options. Gamers are able to choose the color they want by flipping the switch on side of the card. Ice blue shows the Hellhound's coolness, while glacial white projects a crisp, calm, elegance.

### Dual BIOS Mode

Hellhound RX 7900 XT features Dual BIOS built-in and a switch for easy swapping. -OC BIOS: A boosted mode that increases fan RPM to keep your card operating at a lower temperature to drive higher performance. -Silent BIOS: Focused on lower noise and fan longevity, a milder fan speed, trading fan speed and noise for moderate, but still controlled, temperatures while maintaining performance.

AMD FreeSync™ Technology

Take full advantage of the AMD Radeon™ RX 7000 Series graphics cards by pairing with a certified AMD FreeSync™ technology-enabled monitor to enable an exceptional stutter and tear-free gaming experience with high refresh rates, low latency, and stunning HDR.

Radeon™ Anti-Lag

Less lag equals more wins. Radeon Anti-Lag reduces latency, providing ultra-fast response time giving you a dynamic edge over your competition.

Radeon™ Boost

Radeon Boost delivers extra performance and improves game smoothness when fast on-screen character motion is detected via user input.

AMD RDNA™ 3 Architecture with Hardware Raytracing

Description

### Immersive customization

Add a personalized touch to your gaming PC with a uniquely designed graphics card. The different Devil Skin designs will provide a distinctive appearance, allowing you to stand out from the crowd. Embrace uniqueness and enhance the aesthetic of your gaming PC.

### Swappable Backplate Design

Customizing your PC build with a themed Devil Skin (backplate) is made easy for gamers using the Powercolor Red Devil 7000 series, thanks to the magnets on the back. Simply lay the backplate on the back of the card and it will be securely attached by the magnets, providing gamers with flexibility and ease in customizing their PC builds.

### Lightweight Design

Our backplates feature a lightweight design that doesn't compromise on quality. Each element is carefully crafted with suitable materials to minimize weight while maintaining the integrity of the design.

### Streamline Design

The Intrusive backplate design takes inspiration from the sleek and streamlined look of a supercar. With its all-black streamlined panel and silver-colored window louvers, this backplate brings a minimalist yet stylish silhouette to your Powercolor Red Devil 7000 series.

### Intake Port Design as Heat Dissipation vent

The Intrusive backplate features an intake port design inspired by supercars, located on the right side. This design not only adds a stylish touch, but also helps to prevent heat from accumulating between the backplate and your Powercolor Red Devil 7000 card.

### Red Devil 7000 Series Exclusive

All the Devil Skin swappable backplates are only compatible with Red Devil 7000 series.

### Dimension & Compatiable Model

Features

AMD FreeSync™ Technology

Take full advantage of the AMD Radeon™ RX 7000 Series graphics cards by pairing with a certified AMD FreeSync™ technology-enabled monitor to enable an exceptional stutter and tear-free gaming experience with high refresh rates, low latency, and stunning HDR.

Radeon™ Anti-Lag

Less lag equals more wins. Radeon Anti-Lag reduces latency, providing ultra-fast response time giving you a dynamic edge over your competition.

Radeon™ Boost

Radeon Boost delivers extra performance and improves game smoothness when fast on-screen character motion is detected via user input.

8GB GDDR6 Memory

Crunch through game textures with 8GB GDDR6 memory. Get equipped to play the newest games at the highest settings.

AMD RDNA™ 3 Architecture with Hardware Raytracing

The AMD RDNA™ 3 architecture features industry-advancing chiplet technology to deliver next-generation performance, visuals, and power efficiency. Discover new levels of performance with unified AMD RDNA™ 3 compute units, featuring redesigned raytracing accelerators for incredible performance while improving image quality.

Optimized for Windows 11

AMD Radeon™ RX 7000 Series Graphics power the ultimate Windows 11 gaming experience with optimized support for DirectX® 12 Ultimate, AutoHDR, and DirectStorage.

AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution Technology

AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution technology, or FSR, uses cutting-edge super-optimized spatial upscaling technology to generate super high-quality edges and distinctive pixel detail. With FSR, turn on the latest features and settings in your games while maintaining an acceptable framerate.
